# Robo-Garage controller PCB v1.1.1

100 × 100 mm, 2 layers, all SMD parts on top. Made with KiCad 7 + Freerouting (FOSS). DRC: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 unconnected.

**v1.1.1 (DRC clean-up, same parts / BOM / case / firmware):** silkscreen trimmed at the board edge · GND stitching vias about every 8 mm tie the top and bottom pours together (no copper island hangs on one pad any more) · Q3 + C16 GND pins solid to the pour · redundant autorouter tracks removed (CB stub, GND/3V3 jogs at C28). DRC checked in KiCad 7 and KiCad 10 (also after a zone refill).

**New in v1.1:** SHT40 temperature / humidity sensor (auto vent) on a thermally isolated island · light-barrier clamp (BEAM) with emitter self-test.

## Files
| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `robo-garage_gerbers_JLCPCB.zip` | Upload at JLCPCB (PCB) |
| `robo-garage_BOM_JLCPCB.csv` | PCB Assembly: BOM |
| `robo-garage_CPL_JLCPCB.csv` | PCB Assembly: pick & place |
| `robo-garage-pcb.yaml` | ESPHome config for this board |
| `kicad/` | KiCad project to edit later |
| `render_top.png`, `render_bottom.png` | Pictures |

## Order at JLCPCB
1. **PCB:** upload `robo-garage_gerbers_JLCPCB.zip` → 2 layers, 1.6 mm, LeadFree HASL, 1 oz, via covering *Tented*. "Mark on PCB": leave the default (no mark; JLCPCB stopped printing order numbers in May 2026, so the board has no JLCJLCJLCJLC text any more). The C-shaped slot around the SHT40 (bottom right) is intended (heat isolation): confirm if JLC asks.
2. **PCB Assembly:** Economic, top side, 2 boards → upload BOM + CPL.
3. **Check the placement preview:** pin 1 / polarity of U1–U5, Q1–Q5, D1–D3, LED1, C1, C3, C13. **U5 (SHT40): pin-1 mark top left** (towards the slot opening). Rotate in the preview if one looks wrong.
4. THT parts (J2–J12) are marked "THT (hand solder)": untick them in the assembly step and solder them yourself, or order JLC's THT assembly.
5. Out of stock? SHT40 → SHT40-AD1B-R3 (C2848306) or SHT41-AD1B-R2 (C7461861). F3 → any 1206 PTC 200 mA, ≥ 24 V (e.g. C2892415).

## Parts to buy separately (hand solder)
| Part | Qty | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| WAGO 804-102 | 3 | 12V IN, ACTUATOR, (spare) → J2, J5 |
| WAGO 804-103 | 1 | LED → J7 |
| WAGO 804-104 | 2 | BUTTON, I2C → J8, J10 |
| WAGO 804-105 | 1 | BEAM → J12 (new) |
| WAGO 804-106 | 1 | REEDS → J9 |
| 1×19 female header 2.54 mm, 8.5 mm | 2 | DevKitC socket J3 + J4 |
| Molex 47053-1000 (4-pin fan header) | 1 | FAN → J6 |
| Light barrier pair, 12–24 V DC, through-beam, **NPN**, **Light-ON** (often sold as "NC"), e.g. Omron E3Z-T61 set to L-ON. Dark-ON ("NO", e.g. E3F-5DN1) works too → set `beam_inverted: "false"` | 1 | BEAM clamp |

**DevKitC:** must be WROOM-based (not WROVER), because GPIO16/17 are used. Measure your board. 25.4 mm between rows → solder the bottom header into the **outer** row of J4; 22.86 mm → **inner** row.

## Wiring
| Clamp | Pins | Connect |
|---|---|---|
| 12 V IN | +12V, GND | GST36E12 plug → DC-jack adapter → 2 wires |
| ACTUATOR | M+, M− | Actuator. Door moves the wrong way → swap the 2 wires |
| FAN | 4-pin | ARCTIC P12 Slim PWM plug |
| LED | 5V, DAT, GND | WS2812B strip / ring (DIN) |
| BUTTON | BTN, GND, 12V, LED− | Alu button: NO, C, LED+, LED− |
| REEDS | CL/GND, OP/GND, DR/GND | Door closed, door open, drawer reed |
| BEAM (left edge) | RX+, RX−, SIG, TX+, TX− | Receiver: brown, blue, black. Emitter: brown, blue. Beam across the cabinet front, ≈ 12 cm in front of the door and ≈ 2 cm above the floor (past the ramp wedge, under the door's swing) |
| I2C ToF | 3V3, SDA, SCL, GND | VL53L1X module (optional) |

## Pins (ESP32)
| GPIO | Function |
|---|---|
| 25 / 26 | DRV8871 IN1 (open) / IN2 (close) |
| 32 / 33 / 18 | Reed door closed / door open / drawer |
| 19 | Clean button |
| 23 | Button ring (AO3400A, 12 V) |
| 16 | WS2812 data (74AHCT1G125 → 330 Ω) |
| 17 / 27 | Fan PWM (2N7002, inverted) / fan tach |
| 21 / 22 | I²C SDA / SCL (INA219 0x40 + SHT40 0x44 on board, VL53L1X on the clamp) |
| 34 | Light barrier input (via 2N7002, 12 V safe) |
| 13 | Light barrier emitter on/off (AO3400A) |
| 4, 14, 35 | Spare (EXP header; 35 = input only) |

## Sensors and door safety
| Item | How it works |
|---|---|
| SHT40 | Sits on an island with a milled slot, far from ESP32 / buck heat. The case gives it its own vented chamber → it measures cabinet air. Check once against a thermometer, set `offset` in the YAML if needed. Right after soldering, humidity can read a bit low for 1–2 days (normal). |
| Auto vent | Fan on above "Vent humidity limit" (65 %) or "Vent temperature limit" (30 °C), 30–100 % speed in 10 % steps; off again 5 %RH / 1 °C below, and while the drawer is out. "Vent auto" off → fan stops, then HA / manual control. |
| Light barrier | Door does not close while the beam is blocked. Beam broken while closing → stop + reopen. |
| Self-test | Before every close (and every 10 min) the emitter is switched off briefly (max 1.5 s): the receiver must react. If not → "Door beam fault" in HA and the door stays open. With a Light-ON sensor a cut wire or a tripped PTC reads "blocked" at once; with Dark-ON the next self-test catches it. |
| Beam always "Detected" | Nothing in the way? Check the 5 wires, the sensor alignment and F3. |
| Stall stop | Backup: INA219 motor current (unchanged) |

## Power
12 V 3 A in → PTC 2.6 A → reverse-polarity P-FET → TVS 15 V. LMR51430 buck makes 5.1 V (3 A max) for the ESP32 (via Schottky, so USB can stay plugged in) and the LEDs (PTC 1.5 A). The light barrier gets 12 V through its own PTC (200 mA): a short in its cable only trips F3 (the ESP32 may restart once; the door stays safe because the beam then reads "blocked").
Worst case ≈ 2 A from the 12 V adapter. Keep LED brightness low (full white on all LEDs heats the buck).

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| LED clamp | 1.5 A (PTC) ≈ 25 LEDs at full white; 16 LEDs are fine |
| BEAM clamp | 200 mA (PTC) for receiver + emitter (typ. 30–50 mA) |
| Actuator | DRV8871 limits at ≈ 1.9 A (R5 = 33 kΩ) |
| Stall stop | ESPHome `stall_current` (default 0.8 A): set it ≈ 0.3 A above the running current shown in HA |

# ESPHome config for the Robo-Garage controller PCB v1.1 (ESP32 DevKitC V4 plugged in)
# v1.1: SHT40 cabinet temperature / humidity (auto vent), door light barrier with self-test.
# Pin changes vs. the module build: DRV8871 instead of BTS7960 (no EN pin), INA219 on the board,
# fan tach on GPIO27, external pull-ups on reeds / button (internal pull-ups stay on, harmless).
substitutions:
  stall_current: "0.8"   # A: set ~0.3 A above the running current you see in HA ("Door motor current")
  beam_inverted: "true"  # NPN Light-ON receiver (recommended, often sold as "NC") = true; Dark-ON ("NO") = false.
                         # Check: beam clear -> HA "Door beam" must show "Clear". If not, flip this value.

esphome:
  name: robo-garage
  friendly_name: Robo-Garage

esp32:
  board: esp32dev
  framework:
    type: esp-idf

logger:
api:
ota:
  - platform: esphome
wifi:
  ssid: !secret wifi_ssid
  password: !secret wifi_password

i2c:
  sda: GPIO21          # pull-ups 4.7k on the PCB
  scl: GPIO22
  frequency: 100kHz

globals:
  - {id: beam_testing, type: bool, initial_value: "false"}   # emitter is off for the self-test
  - {id: beam_dark_ok, type: bool, initial_value: "true"}    # last self-test: receiver saw "no light"

output:
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO25, id: door_open_out}          # DRV8871 IN1 -> actuator extends
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO26, id: door_close_out}         # DRV8871 IN2 -> actuator retracts
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO23, id: btn_ring_out}           # AO3400A -> button ring (12 V)
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO17, id: fan_pwm, frequency: 25000Hz, inverted: true}  # 2N7002 open drain

switch:
  - platform: gpio                                             # AO3400A -> light barrier emitter (TX-)
    id: beam_tx
    pin: GPIO13
    restore_mode: ALWAYS_ON
    internal: true
  - platform: template
    id: vent_auto
    name: "Vent auto"                                          # off = fan only from HA / manual
    optimistic: true
    restore_mode: RESTORE_DEFAULT_ON
    entity_category: config
    on_turn_off:
      - fan.turn_off: rear_fan

number:
  - platform: template
    id: vent_hum_on
    name: "Vent humidity limit"
    unit_of_measurement: "%"
    min_value: 40
    max_value: 90
    step: 1
    initial_value: 65
    optimistic: true
    restore_value: true
    entity_category: config
  - platform: template
    id: vent_temp_on
    name: "Vent temperature limit"
    unit_of_measurement: "°C"
    min_value: 20
    max_value: 45
    step: 0.5
    initial_value: 30
    optimistic: true
    restore_value: true
    entity_category: config

binary_sensor:
  - {platform: gpio, id: door_closed_reed, name: "Door closed", pin: {number: GPIO32, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true}}
  - {platform: gpio, id: door_open_reed, name: "Door open", pin: {number: GPIO33, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true}}
  - {platform: gpio, id: drawer_reed, name: "Drawer", device_class: opening,
     pin: {number: GPIO18, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: false}}            # on = drawer out
  - {platform: gpio, name: "Clean button", pin: {number: GPIO19, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true},
     filters: [delayed_on: 30ms]}
  - platform: template                                         # stall stop (INA219 on the PCB)
    id: door_stall
    name: "Door stall"
    lambda: return id(motor_current).state > ${stall_current};
    filters: [delayed_on: 400ms]                               # ignores the start-up inrush
    on_press:
      - cover.stop: door
      - logger.log: "Door stall -> stopped"
  # ---- light barrier (BEAM clamp): IO34 low = SIG high = receiver output off ----
  - platform: gpio
    id: beam_raw
    internal: true
    pin: {number: GPIO34, inverted: "${beam_inverted}"}       # input-only pin, pull-up R36 on the PCB
    filters: [delayed_on_off: 5ms]
    on_press:                                                  # unfiltered edge: beam broken while closing
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return !id(beam_testing) && id(door).current_operation == cover::COVER_OPERATION_CLOSING;'
          then:
            - logger.log: "Beam blocked while closing -> reopen"
            - cover.stop: door
            - delay: 300ms
            - cover.open: door
  - platform: template
    id: beam
    name: "Door beam"                                          # on = something in the door opening (HA display)
    device_class: occupancy
    lambda: |-
      if (id(beam_testing)) return {};                         // self-test running: keep the last state
      return id(beam_raw).state;
    filters: [delayed_off: 300ms]
  - platform: template
    id: beam_fault
    name: "Door beam fault"                                    # on = receiver did not react to the emitter
    device_class: problem

script:
  - id: beam_selftest                                          # emitter off -> receiver must report "no light"
    mode: single
    then:
      - lambda: 'id(beam_testing) = true;'
      - switch.turn_off: beam_tx
      - wait_until:                                            # receiver must drop out (max 0.5 s)
          condition:
            binary_sensor.is_on: beam_raw
          timeout: 500ms
      - lambda: 'id(beam_dark_ok) = id(beam_raw).state;'
      - switch.turn_on: beam_tx
      - wait_until:                                            # and see the beam again (max 1 s)
          condition:
            binary_sensor.is_off: beam_raw
          timeout: 1s
      - lambda: 'id(beam_testing) = false;'
      - binary_sensor.template.publish:
          id: beam_fault
          state: !lambda 'return !id(beam_dark_ok);'

sensor:
  - platform: ina219                                           # on the PCB, shunt 0.1 ohm
    address: 0x40
    shunt_resistance: 0.1 ohm
    max_voltage: 16V
    max_current: 3.2A
    update_interval: 100ms
    current:
      name: "Door motor current"
      id: motor_current
    bus_voltage:
      name: "12 V supply"
  - platform: sht4x                                            # SHT40 on the PCB island
    address: 0x44
    update_interval: 30s
    temperature:
      name: "Cabinet temperature"
      id: cab_temp
      filters: [offset: 0.0]                                   # set after a check with a reference thermometer
    humidity:
      name: "Cabinet humidity"
      id: cab_hum
  - platform: pulse_counter                                    # fan tach, 2 pulses per turn
    pin: {number: GPIO27, mode: INPUT_PULLUP}
    name: "Rear fan speed"
    unit_of_measurement: rpm
    filters: [multiply: 0.5]
    update_interval: 10s

fan:
  - {platform: speed, id: rear_fan, output: fan_pwm, name: "Rear fan"}

interval:
  - interval: 30s                                              # auto vent from the SHT40
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            switch.is_on: vent_auto
          then:
            - lambda: |-
                if (id(drawer_reed).state) {                       // drawer out: no fan while you work at the station
                  if (id(rear_fan).state) id(rear_fan).turn_off().perform();
                  return;
                }
                const float h = id(cab_hum).state, t = id(cab_temp).state;
                if (std::isnan(h) || std::isnan(t)) return;
                const float h_on = id(vent_hum_on).state, t_on = id(vent_temp_on).state;
                static bool running = false;
                if (h > h_on || t > t_on) running = true;
                else if (h < h_on - 5.0f && t < t_on - 1.0f) running = false;   // 5 %RH / 1 degC hysteresis
                if (!running) {
                  if (id(rear_fan).state) id(rear_fan).turn_off().perform();
                  return;
                }
                // 30 % at the switch-off point, 100 % at limit + 15 %RH or + 6 degC, in 10 % steps
                const float x = std::max((h - h_on + 5.0f) / 20.0f, (t - t_on + 1.0f) / 7.0f);
                const float s = 30.0f + 70.0f * std::min(std::max(x, 0.0f), 1.0f);
                const int speed = 10 * (int) roundf(s / 10.0f);
                if (!id(rear_fan).state || id(rear_fan).speed != speed)
                  id(rear_fan).turn_on().set_speed(speed).perform();
  - interval: 10min                                            # beam self-test while the door is idle
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return id(door).current_operation == cover::COVER_OPERATION_IDLE;'
          then:
            - script.execute: beam_selftest

cover:
  - platform: endstop
    id: door
    name: "Robo-Garage Door"
    device_class: garage
    open_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_close_out
      - output.turn_on: door_open_out
    open_endstop: door_open_reed
    open_duration: 11s
    close_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_open_out
      - script.execute: beam_selftest                          # 0.1-1.5 s before every close
      - script.wait: beam_selftest
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return id(beam_dark_ok) && !id(beam_raw).state;'   # sensor works and beam is clear
          then:
            - output.turn_on: door_close_out
          else:
            - logger.log: "Door stays open: beam blocked or beam fault"
            - cover.open: door                                 # back to fully open (no-op if already open)
    close_endstop: door_closed_reed
    close_duration: 11s
    max_duration: 15s
    stop_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_open_out
      - output.turn_off: door_close_out

light:
  - {platform: monochromatic, name: "Clean button ring", output: btn_ring_out}
  - platform: esp32_rmt_led_strip
    id: status_led
    name: "Robo-Garage Status LED"
    pin: GPIO16                                                # via 74AHCT1G125 level shifter
    num_leds: 16
    chipset: WS2812
    channel_colors: GRB
    effects:
      - pulse: {name: "Slow pulse", transition_length: 1s, update_interval: 1s}
      - strobe: {name: "Error strobe"}
      - addressable_scan: {name: "Chase"}
      - addressable_color_wipe: {name: "Spinner"}

# Optional VL53L1X (robot in bay) on the I2C clamp: needs an external ESPHome component.

# Robo-Garage controller PCB - parts, footprints, nets, placement, LCSC numbers (single source of truth)
# Coordinates in mm, KiCad board coords (x right, y down); board 100 x 100 mm, top-left at (0, 0).
# rot = KiCad footprint rotation in degrees (CCW).

W, H = 100.0, 100.0

# ---- ESP32 DevKitC V4: top row = DevKit J3 side, bottom row = J2 side (dual column 22.86 / 25.4 mm) ----
J3_PINS = ['GND', 'IO23', 'IO22', 'TXD', 'RXD', 'IO21', 'GND', 'IO19', 'IO18', 'IO5', 'IO17', 'IO16', 'IO4',
